Arthur.day_scenario: Arthur rises promptly at 6:00 AM to water the tomato stakes and prune the overgrown basil before the morning mist clears. Later, he settles into his study with the Tuesday edition of the paper, carefully tightening the loose hinge on the back door while his afternoon lunch of soup sits cooling on the side table.
